description: This file defines utility functions for string manipulation within Apache Spark, including hex formatting, string truncation, padding, and side-by-side display, as well as a singleton object extending these utilities with logging and additional features.

classes.name: SparkStringUtils
classes.description: A trait providing various string utility methods, including hex conversion, string checks, abbreviations, side-by-side display, and string splitting.

classes.name: SparkStringUtils
classes.description: An object extending the trait with additional static methods and logging capabilities, including string truncation with warning management.

methods.name: getHexString
methods.description: Returns a pretty hex string representation of a byte array with spaces between bytes.

methods.name: fromHexString
methods.description: Parses a hex string (with spaces) into a byte array.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if a string is null or empty.

methods.name: isNotEmpty
methods.description: Checks if a string is not null and not empty.

methods.name: isBlank
methods.description: Checks if a string is null or blank.

methods.name: isNotBlank
methods.description: Checks if a string is not null and not blank.

methods.name: abbreviate
methods.description: Abbreviates a string to a specified length, appending an abbreviation marker if truncated.

methods.name: sideBySide
methods.description: Displays two strings or sequences side by side, aligning lines.

methods.name: stringToSeq
methods.description: Splits a comma-separated string into a sequence of trimmed, non-empty strings.

methods.name: strip
methods.description: Removes specified prefix and suffix from a string if present.

methods.name: leftPad
methods.description: Pads a string on the left to a specified width.

methods.name: rightPad
methods.description: Pads a string on the right to a specified width.

methods.name: rightPad
methods.description: Pads a string on the right with a specified string to a specified width.

methods.name: truncatedString
methods.description: Formats a sequence into a string, truncating and indicating omitted elements if exceeding maxFields, with optional custom string conversion.
